column1: # Skills to install (upstream repo, skill name, optional SkillRelPath, disabled flag)
# skillRelPath: leave empty for default "skills/<name>", or specify custom path
# disabled: "true" to park in skills._disabled/ with SKILL.md.disabled
# loop-engineering, watch-skill, wigolo, archify: these are CLI/MCP tools, not
# installable skills. They were hand-authored placeholder entries that never
# had a SKILL.md. The CLIs are installed in Phase 2 (uv/npm), and the MCP
# servers are in mcp.json.template. Removed from the skills manifest.
# PATH FIX 2026-09-13: upstream restructured and the skill now lives at
# skills/i-have-adhd/ (the legacy .cursor/skills/i-have-adhd/ copy also still exists).
# The old .cursor path was left in this manifest after the move, so the row would
# fail with "SKILL.md not found" on any fresh machine. Repointed at the canonical
# skills/ path; both copies gate PASS.
# oz-skills (JZKK720 fork of orca/oz-skills). 14 active, 1 blocked by SkillSpector (webapp-testing: HIGH TM1).
# webapp-testing: upstream blocked by SkillSpector (HIGH TM1 — shell=True in scripts/with_server.py).
# Ported as a clean methodology-only skill (no bundled scripts) -> local/webapp-testing.
# idea-to-design: hand-authored clean port of obra/superpowers brainstorming.
# Upstream blocked by SkillSpector (tool parameter abuse in stop-server.sh visual companion).
# This port removes the browser server entirely; pure process methodology only.
# design-md-library: hand-authored wrapper skill (Option B). Indexes the VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
# fork mirror (74 DESIGN.md files, Google Stitch spec). Source lives at ~/dev/upstream/design-md-library/.
# Fork mirror: ~/dev/forks/JZKK720/awesome-design-md/. Not a direct upstream install.
# gstack-review is a hand-adapted port (MIT, from garrytan/gstack via JZKK720/gstack fork).
# Not a direct install: the upstream review/SKILL.md (61 KB, templated via .tmpl + sections/)
# carries a Claude-Code shell preamble that breaks under VS Code Copilot. The adapted version
# lives at ~/.agents/skills/gstack-review/ with a 112-line SKILL.md plus reference/ files
# copied verbatim from the fork's review/ dir (checklist, design-checklist, TODOS-format,
# Re-create manually if missing; do not re-install from the fork (it would overwrite the port).
# Refreshed 2026-09-13 from the then-current fork HEAD; SKILL.md gained a section 7 that maps
# each review layer to its reference file so the copied docs are actually discoverable.
# agent loop design. All pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). No MCP deps, plain SKILL.md.
# Added 2026-09-13: upstream ships 7 skills; these 2 were missing from the manifest.
# budget-negotiator - L3 autonomous loops: on near-exhausted token budget the agent
#   drafts a reasoned budget-increase request instead of silently failing.
# install-loop     - installs Loop Engineering via the unified @cobusgreyling/loop CLI
#   front door; week-one is report-only and it refuses auto-merge unless a human asks.
# coupling. Passes SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Skill is at repo root <name>/SKILL.md
# (not under skills/), so relPath is just the folder name.
# ported as methodology-only. Upstream uses mcp__codex__codex, $ARGUMENTS, Bash(*),
# research-wiki, GPU pilots — all Claude-Code-specific. Ports strip those deps, keeping
# the core research methodology (landscape survey, idea generation, novelty check).
# All 3 ports pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE) and skills-ref validate.
# All pass SkillSpector (17 LOW/SAFE, 7 MEDIUM/CAUTION, 0 blocked).
# test-driven-development is SKIPPED (duplicate of obra/superpowers one already installed).
# constraint-driven-development: added 2026-09-13. New upstream skill that writes a
# project's quality bar into CONSTRAINTS.md and then watches the diff for a weakened bar
# (@ts-ignore / eslint-disable, skipped or deleted tests, assertions stripped, stubs,
# thresholds edited down). It is the enforcement counterpart to the prose guidance in
# already in this bundle. Ships references/floor-guard.md alongside SKILL.md.
# All pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Includes create-design-md (not in README's
# original 6, but it's in the repo and passes scan).
# --- ECC skills (evan-ai/ECC): 35 universal skills from agent harness OS ---
# All pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Curated from 278 ECC skills — framework-specific,
# ECC-internal, and domain-niche skills excluded. Fork mirror: ~/dev/forks/JZKK720/ECC/
# --- ECC upstream new-skills triage (8 skills appeared 2026-08-16..09-12) ---
# Evaluated by running skillspector scan --no-llm on each. Two pass and are in
# scope (framework-agnostic agent-safety), two pass but are OUT of scope by this
# bundle's own curation rule ("framework-agnostic only; framework-specific,
# ECC-internal, and domain-niche excluded"), and two are blocked by the gate.
#   counterparty-channel-discipline - mention gating, silent observation and a
#     communication autonomy policy for agents in shared channels with external
#     counterparties. Prevents leaking internal context to outsiders.
#   operator-approval-loop - hashed drafts, epoch-keyed approvals, durable
#     delivery receipts and a pre-draft baseline gate for agent-drafted outbound
#     messages. Human operator approves/rejects/steers each send.
# PASSED THE GATE BUT OUT OF SCOPE - deliberately not installed:
#   rails-patterns             - Ruby on Rails 7.1+/8.x framework patterns. There is
#                                no other Rails entry in this manifest; installing one
#   tasteforge-video           - orchestrator over the taste video stack. Its siblings
#                                so it would ship as an entry point to nothing.
#   master-agreement-generator - legal drafting (counterparty master agreements from a
#   esign-field-placement      - e-signature envelope field placement via browser
# BLOCKED BY SKILLSPECTOR - parked as comments so the gate result stays visible:
#   taste-application   CRITICAL SC4 vulnerable deps (numpy, Pillow, setuptools x10 advisories)
#                       + HIGH AR2 anti-refusal statement + HIGH E2 env var harvesting
#                       + HIGH OH1 unvalidated output injection. Ships 61 script files.
#   taste-distillation  CRITICAL + MEDIUM AST4 subprocess calls + MEDIUM AST3 dynamic import.
# open-code-review: deterministic + agent hybrid code review via `ocr` CLI.
# open-code-review-delegate: delegation mode — host agent drives review, OCR
# handles file selection + rule resolution only (no OCR-side LLM needed).
# Both pass SkillSpector (pure markdown prompts, no bundled scripts).
# These are LOCAL ported copies (source: this repo's upstream/open-code-review/),
# deliberately NOT installed from alibaba/open-code-review. Verified 2026-09-13:
# upstream ships its own skills/open-code-review/SKILL.md at a different sha than the
# port, so a direct install would silently replace the Copilot-tuned wording. The
# ocr CLI itself is installed from upstream separately (see CLIs table).
# Note: ~/dev/forks/JZKK720/open-code-review/ is a plain 2-file copy, not a git
# checkout, so sync-fork-upstreams.ps1 correctly SKIPs it as "not a git checkout".
# --- impeccable ports (pbakaus/impeccable, Apache-2.0): 6 pure-prose design methodology skills ---
# Ported 2026-07-28. Upstream is a full application (CLI + browser extension + live server + hooks).
# These ports extract only the reference prose docs as standalone methodology skills.
# All 6 pass SkillSpector (5x 0/100 SAFE, 1x 7/100 SAFE) and skills-ref validate.
# Copilot is a documented first-class target; zero $ARGUMENTS/mcp__ coupling in skill bodies.
# 32 skills total; we cherry-pick the planning/execution/compounding/debug/git/autonomous skills.
# SKIP ce-code-review and ce-resolve-pr-feedback — they duplicate existing bundle review skills
# SKIP ce-proof (needs Every's hosted API), ce-test-xcode (needs XcodeBuildMCP), ce-riffrec (needs Riffrec).
# SKIP ce-polish, ce-dogfood (manual-only, browser-based, not model-invoked).
# The 9 entries below are advertised by upstream EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin but
# every one of them fails the SkillSpector hard gate (exit 1, do_not_install). Leaving them
# in the manifest made install-missing-skills.ps1 retry and re-block them on every run,
# reporting "BLOCKED" 9 times with no path to a different outcome. They are parked here as
# comments instead so the gate result stays visible without being re-attempted.
# See the blocked-skills table in README.md for the per-skill reason code.
#   ce-compound      HIGH E4 context leakage + HIGH RA1 self-modification
#   ce-optimize      HIGH TM1 - tool parameter abuse
#   ce-babysit-pr    HIGH YR1 - YARA destructive autonomous actions
# Zero Claude-Code coupling; Copilot explicitly supported. Each ships stdlib-only
# Python scripts with CI-eval-gated tests. Apache-2.0.
# SKIP self-improving-agent-skills (standalone FastAPI+Next.js web app, not a drop-in skill).
# SKIP advisor-orchestrator-worker, thinking-out-loud (lighter value, can add later).
# BLOCKED BY SKILLSPECTOR (pruned 2026-09-13) - both fail with MEDIUM RP1 (unpinned MCP)
# plus HIGH OH1 (unvalidated output injection). Parked as comments so the install-missing
# pass stops retrying and re-blocking them on every run.
# --- archify (tt-a1i, MIT, v2.17): interactive architecture diagram skill ---
# Turns plain-English system descriptions or codebases into self-contained HTML
# diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle). Typed JSON IR,
# validation, PNG/SVG/WebM export. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode.
# BLOCKED BY SKILLSPECTOR (re-confirmed 2026-09-13): exit 1, HIGH MP3 "Memory
# Manipulation", reported against the bundled MCP metadata. The earlier note here
# recorded the same block as "HIGH YR4 agent_skill_mcp_tool_poisoning_metadata"; the
# rule has been re-classified since, but the verdict is unchanged and the block is real.
# A clean methodology-only port now supplies this skill instead, following the same
# pattern used for book-to-skill, diagram-design, webapp-testing and brainstorming.
# The port keeps the authoring contract, type router, invariant list, Mermaid
# conversion rules and the validate -> deliver -> visual-check sequence. It drops the
# renderer, schemas, examples and brand-mark database, which is where the gate fired.
# Source lives at upstream/archify/SKILL.md and gates 0/100 SAFE.
# COST OF THIS DECISION: a port is methodology only. Upstream's real value is its
# validated renderer (bin/archify.mjs validate, 9 showcase checks) and that is not
# installed. The SKILL.md tells the agent to use the fork-mirror checkout for the CLI
# and to report truthfully if it is absent, rather than implying a pass.
# --- book-to-skill (virgiliojr94, MIT): convert books into agent skills ---
# Converts PDF/EPUB/DOCX/HTML/Markdown/RTF/MOBI into structured agent skills
# (frameworks, mental models, decision rules, anti-patterns). Generates per-
# chapter files loaded on-demand. Upstream blocked by SkillSpector (CRITICAL,
# 100/100 - bundled Python scripts with subprocess/dynamic imports). Clean
# methodology-only port uses the bundle's `markitdown` for extraction.
# Chinese/English design skill for prototypes, slides, animations, infographics,
# expert reviews. 40+ design styles, references, assets, scripts. Agent-agnostic
# (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). SKILL.md sits at the repo ROOT
# (not under skills/), so SkillRelPath must be "." or install fails with
# "SKILL.md not found at skills/huashu-design". That path bug is fixed, but the entry is
# BLOCKED by SkillSpector anyway: HIGH SC4 known vulnerable dependency sharp==0.34.5
# (2 advisories). Pruned 2026-09-13 so the install-missing pass stops retrying it.
# --- anti-slop (miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop, MIT): anti-AI-slop design & copy rules ---
# 38 rules across 3 tiers (Hard Gate / Purpose-Gate / Quality Locks) + Liveliness
# Toolkit + mandatory Delivery Gate. Upstream ships a raw antislop.md (not yet a
# SKILL.md); hand-ported as a clean methodology-only skill (no scripts/assets).
# Source lives at upstream/anti-slop/SKILL.md. Complements hallmark, taste-skill,
# 29 diagram types (architecture, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER, timeline,
# swimlane, quadrant, radar, Venn, Gantt, medallion, DP security matrix) as
# self-contained HTML/SVG/PNG. Import .drawio / Mermaid .mmd. Upstream blocked
# by SkillSpector (HIGH, 55/100 - HTML assets flagged as P2 hidden instructions).
# Clean methodology-only port retains the full prose; assets referenced from
# --- claudex (formerly crucible; chaseai-yt, MIT, 1.2k★): cross-model adversarial plan hardening ---
# UPSTREAM RENAME (2026-09-06, commit a027430 "rebrand: crucible -> claudex-loop"):
#   skills/crucible  ->  skills/claudex-loop   (legacy /crucible trigger kept in its description)

column1: # Note: the repo is still hosted at chaseai-yt/crucible — only the in-repo dirs were renamed.
# Passes SkillSpector. Complements doubt-driven-development, council, systematic-debugging.
# RETIRED: `crucible` no longer exists upstream. The already-installed ~/.agents/skills/crucible/
# is the pre-rename snapshot; claudex-loop supersedes it (it answers the legacy /crucible trigger).
# Kept here as a comment so the history is traceable rather than silently dropped.
# Runs decisions through 5 AI advisors with peer review. Different approach
# from ECC's council (4-voice): 5 advisors + explicit peer-review phase.
# SKILL.md at repo root. Passes SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE — pure prose, no scripts).
# --- context-engineering-kit (NeoLabHQ, MIT, 1.3k★): hand-crafted context eng skills ---
# 65 skills total; we cherry-pick 35 genuinely unique ones (no overlap with existing
# bundle skills). Passes SkillSpector with 9B LLM: LOW/SAFE (static CRITICAL was YARA
# false positives on prompt-injection documentation patterns, correctly downgraded by
# LLM meta-analyzer). Includes CodeRabbit open-source alternative. Multi-harness compat
# --- evidence-graph-review (methodology extraction from reverse-skill): scope/evidence/finding/path contract ---
# Clean methodology-only port; no scripts, no toolchain coupling.
# Clean methodology-only port; no scripts, no toolchain coupling.
# 104 candidate skills were gated with `skillspector scan --no-llm`. Adopted entries
# below are all exit 0. Gate-blocked and high-finding entries are parked as comments
# with their reason codes so the gate result stays visible without being re-attempted.
# Skills live at packages/skills-catalog/skills/(category)/<name>/ — the parentheses are
# literal, so every row needs an explicit -SkillRelPath.
# NAME COLLISION HANDLED: the naive fork name for this repo is `agent-skills`, which is
# ALREADY TAKEN by JZKK720/agent-skills (the addyosmani mirror used by 23 existing rows).
# The (architecture) block below is adopted AS A SET: it is one DDD methodology staged
# as six skills that reference each other. Installing a subset would leave dangling
# references. All gate PASS with no high findings.
# create-technical-design-doc is a 1055-line technical-design-doc guide — the deepest
# planning artifact in any candidate. Pairs with documentation-and-adrs.
# harness-eval audits an agent harness (AGENTS.md, rules, skills, skill refs) for broken
# paths/commands, redundancy and dead references. This bundle's own manifest + MCP config
# are exactly that surface, so it is directly useful here.
# spec-driven-eval scores an implementation against a PRD/spec case by case.
# not-your-babysitter = evidence-before-completion discipline for autonomous work.
# learning-opportunities offers deliberate-practice exercises after architectural work.
# EXCLUDED FROM THIS CATALOG — gate PASS but HIGH findings (not installed):
#   the-fool, the-jury            HIGH AR2 anti-refusal statement
#   core-web-vitals, seo, web-best-practices  HIGH P2 hidden instructions
#   security-best-practices       HIGH OH1 unvalidated output injection
#   create-adr, tlc-spec-driven, figma-implement-design  HIGH E4 context leakage
#   vercel-deploy, react-native-expert  HIGH PE3 credential access
#   cloudflare-deploy, sentry     HIGH E2 env variable harvesting
#   react-best-practices          HIGH OH1 unvalidated output injection
#   security-ownership-map        HIGH P6 direct prompt extraction
#   (gtm) category — all 18 skills (ai-cold-outreach, ai-pricing, ai-sdr, ai-seo,
# The repo also ships tools/ (60+ integration .js files under clis/, composio/,
# integrations/) as a separate optional layer. That tree is deliberately NOT installed:
# it is a broad third-party integration surface that should not land on a user machine
# silently, and none of the adopted skills require it.
# Adopted on the bundle's framework-agnostic rule: general marketing discipline in,
# platform-specific execution out. Largely closes the marketing gap (the bundle
# previously had only seo-aeo-audit, brand-discovery, brand-voice, marketing-campaign).
# marketing-loops — recurring self-running marketing workflows; bridges to the bundle's
# EXCLUDED — ad-creative is BLOCKED (exit 1). marketing-plan is HIGH AR1 anti-refusal.
# EXCLUDED BY SCOPE: ads, meta-ads, linkedin-ads, tiktok-ads, google-ads (platform);
#   seo-audit, ai-seo, programmatic-seo, site-architecture, schema (overlap seo-aeo-audit);
#   emails, cold-email, sms, popups, social, video, image, events, public-relations,
#   lead-magnets, referrals, co-marketing, partnerstack, prospecting, sales-enablement,
#   revops, customer-research, attribution, analytics, cro, a-b-testing, onboarding,
#   paywalls, signup, churn-prevention, aso, copy-editing, marketing-council,
# The repo root has NO LICENSE file, but every skill directory ships its own LICENSE.txt
# and the sampled set (including all five below) is Apache-2.0, matching the README.
# The repo carries a deprecation notice pointing at openai/plugins, but the skills
# remain permissively licensed and self-contained. Provenance recorded here deliberately.
# NAME COLLISION HANDLED: `JZKK720/skills` is ALREADY a fork of vercel-labs/skills, so
# the naive name would have collided with unrelated content. Forked as JZKK720/openai-skills.
# figma — the bundle already configures the Figma MCP but ships no workflow contract for
#   it. This supplies the required flow (get_design_context -> get_metadata ->
#   get_screenshot -> implement), asset handling, and design-token discipline.
# screenshot — OS-level desktop/window/region capture with a save-location rule and a
#   macOS permission preflight. The bundle has browser capture (Playwright tools) but no
#   desktop capture. Complements the browser MCPs.
# pdf / transcribe — document and audio workflows; complement markitdown and watch-skill.
# security-threat-model — structured threat modelling; complements security-review and
#   figma-use              HIGH P6 direct prompt extraction (sibling of the adopted figma;
#                          the block is specific to figma-use's content)
#   security-ownership-map HIGH P6 direct prompt extraction — blocked here AND in the
#                          tech-leads-club catalog, i.e. two independent copies agree
# EXCLUDED — gate PASS but HIGH findings: speech (P6), jupyter-notebook (RA1),
#   cli-creator (AS1), sentry (SC2); speech and sentry also overlap existing skills.
# EXCLUDED — the whole skills/.system set (5 skills). Two are BLOCKED and three are HIGH,
#   and all five describe Codex's OWN skill/plugin system, which is not this harness:
#   imagegen BLOCK HIGH P6 · skill-installer BLOCK HIGH E2 env harvesting ·
#   openai-docs HIGH P6 · plugin-creator HIGH RA1 · skill-creator HIGH RA1
# EXCLUDED BY SCOPE: chatgpt-apps, gh-address-comments, gh-fix-ci, linear, notion-* (4),
#   render-deploy, netlify-deploy, vercel-deploy, cloudflare-deploy, winui-app, yeet,
# --- prose de-slopping: two independent implementations, kept as complements ---
# The bundle already ships write-concisely (density) and brand-voice (derive a voice from
# source). Neither covers de-slopping EXISTING prose, which is what the AIS-style track
# inside anti-autoresearch audits for. These two are not duplicates of each other:
# humanizer (blader/humanizer, MIT, v3.0) — 291 lines. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI
# writing". Numbered tells ranked strongest-first, with explicit weak-alone marking that
# requires corroborating tells before acting; plus voice preservation and a fiction
# exemption. No name collision: verified 2026-09-13 that no other installed skill is
# called `humanizer` (only `improve` / `improve-ui` match the substring), so it keeps its
# upstream name. (An earlier draft of this row renamed it `humanizer-prose` on the
# assumption that the name was taken; that assumption was wrong and is corrected here.)
# SKILL.md sits at the repo ROOT, not under skills/. The installer's default relPath is
# "skills/<name>", which does not exist here, so the row passes "." explicitly — the same
# convention already used by the (now-retired) huashu-design row. Installing from upstream
# rather than porting is deliberate: the helper does a byte-level Copy-Item, so the file's
# UTF-8 encoding is preserved. A local port would have required re-encoding the text
# through PowerShell, and an earlier draft of this row was mojibake-corrupted that way.
# no-ai-slop (petergyang/no-ai-slop, MIT) — 61 lines, dense. Two modes (edit / detect),
# banned word list, named pattern catalogue, self-check against eval.md. Gates 0 findings
# at any severity. The compact counterweight to the 291-line humanizer.
# show-me — visual explanation of the current topic: small diagrams, code-shape sketches,
#   focused HTML artifacts. Complements ce-explain and diagram-design.
# improve-claude-md — rewrites instruction files using `<important if>` blocks so
#   conditionally-relevant guidance is not discounted by the harness. KEPT UNDER ITS
#   UPSTREAM NAME deliberately: the technique works by mirroring the XML tag pattern in
#   Claude Code's OWN system prompt, so it is genuinely Claude-Code-specific. Renaming it
#   to something harness-neutral would claim a generality it does not have. Claude Code is
#   a first-class target here (the installer mirrors to ~/.claude/skills), so the skill is
# narrow-react-prop-types — narrows component prop types to what is actually used.
#   Framework-flavoured but stack-generic; the bundle ships no other prop-narrowing content.
# EXCLUDED — both gate PASS but carry HIGH E2 env variable harvesting, and both overlap
# continuous-agent-loop, loop-design-check and the @cobusgreyling/loop CLI already present:
# A crew/supervisor orchestration system. 21 of 22 passed the gate, but most are bound to
# firstmate's own daemon and bin/fm-*.sh scripts, so they are not portable. The four below
# are genuinely universal and carry no runtime dependency.
# bearings             — orientation snapshot for a fresh agent joining a session
# BLOCKED (exit 1): stow — HIGH E4 context leakage.
# EXCLUDED — gate PASS but HIGH findings: harness-adapters (AS1 agent config dir access),
#   updatefirstmate is the one that would be worth de-daemonising later; excluded for now.
# EXCLUDED — daemon/script-bound (bin/fm-*.sh, FM_AFK_* flags): afk, quiet, ahoy,
